data.body: [severity:medium][CWE-693] The no-host-effect gate recognizes `extern crate` only when both tokens occur on one physical line. Rust permits whitespace between them, so `extern\ncrate std as s;` is not counted. The crate can then use `s::fs`, `s::process`, or other host APIs. The planted control still references `std::net`, so the alias can preserve the expected unresolved-`std` failure. The INV-015 audit repeats the same line-local scan at crates/continuumd/tests/inv015_agent_least_authority_evidence.rs:467-476. This lets the claimed no-ambient-authority evidence remain green after host authority is added. Parse Rust syntax or otherwise reject any std linkage, and add a split-token aliased-std mutant.

[severity:medium][CWE-693] The exhaustive search key omits event history for five of six configurations, but candidate generation depends on that history through the global Submitted-event count at lines 552-563. For example, Submit; Crash(keep=0); Restart and Crash(empty); Restart reach the same key but have different submitted counts and therefore different next values and remaining submit budgets. Whichever path reaches the key second is pruned at line 859. The claimed complete 53,224-state exploration and its traceability evidence can therefore miss reachable successors. Include every generator-relevant counter in ModelKey, or make candidate generation depend only on keyed state, then re-pin the count and add a collision regression.

See the open findings. 2) Edge cases: zero and exhausted crash budgets, 64 nodes, pending bound one, exact retained-byte boundaries, MAX_STEPS, overlapping sync ranges, crash after Persist, crash before Persist, restart epochs, torn tails across repeated crashes, and fenced acknowledgements. 3) Rollback: revert this commit before publishing profile 0.1.0. Static review covered all 12 changed files and git diff --check. Tests were not executed because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata. This review does not satisfy the separate risk:critical human gate.

data.body: [severity:medium][CWE-693] The new lexer treats every double quote as an ordinary string opener and raw_token rejects r-prefixed raw strings only when r starts a token. It therefore misses valid raw byte strings. For example, place pub const D: &[u8] = br#""//"#; extern crate std as q; on one line, then use q::fs on the next line. Rust sees the raw byte string and the std declaration. lex closes at the first content quote, treats the two slashes as a comment, and removes the real declaration. The br prefix also defeats raw_token because r follows b. The planted direct std use can still fail while the aliased host path compiles. The same defect exists at crates/continuum-effects-network/tests/pr15_no_std_lane.rs:34, crates/continuum-effects-process/tests/pr15_no_std_lane.rs:37, crates/continuumd/tests/inv015_agent_least_authority_evidence.rs:403, and tools/governance/obligations/gov4_pack_kernel.py:192. Recognize every Rust raw literal prefix before comment stripping, and add this exact mutant to all three lanes, INV-015, and the governance fixtures.

data.body: [severity:medium][CWE-693] The exhaustive differential still collapses histories that differ at the global step bound. `ModelKey` records the submitted count and records retained bytes only for the one small-budget configuration, but it never records `events.len()`. `Delay` at lines 373-383 appends an event without changing the keyed semantic state. The real handler refuses every step once `events.len() >= MAX_STEPS` at crates/continuum-effects-storage/src/lab.rs:459-461, while the reference model has no equivalent check. Under the five `MAX_RETAINED_CAP` configurations, `Sync(0)` followed by repeated `Delay(0)` therefore reaches the same key until the real handler changes from accept to `Bound::Steps`; line 871 prunes that path after its first repeated key. The pinned 78,708-state result is not the claimed complete reachable exploration and can false-green history-dependent defects. The separate boundary test verifies the current handler, but it does not make this differential exhaustive. Include every transition-affecting history quantity in the quotient and reference model, or narrow the exhaustive claim and traceability to the actually checked pre-bound state space. Add a collision regression that compares accept/refuse successors, not only candidate lists.

data.body: [severity:medium][CWE-693] The no-host-effect structure gate still accepts ambient build-environment reads. The banned identifier set at lines 364-374 omits the built-in `env!` and `option_env!` macros. A pack can add `pub const MODE: Option<&str> = option_env!("CONTINUUM_MODE");` while keeping `#![no_std]`, no dependencies, no build script, and exactly `extern crate alloc;`. Both compiler profiles compile, the planted `std` control still fails, and all Rust structure checks return clean. The Python governance twin has the same omission at tools/governance/rust_lexer.py:269-271. The resulting pack behavior and canonical artifacts can now depend on an ambient host environment, contrary to INV-005 and the no-environment claim at crates/continuum-effects-storage/src/lib.rs:87-97. Ban both macro identifiers in both twins and add clean/violation corpus cases that prove literals do not count but real invocations fail.

data.body: [severity:medium][CWE-693] The compiler lane parses Cargo.toml keys as raw text, so TOML quoted keys bypass its build-script guard. For example, under [package], `"build" = "../ambient.rs"` is the semantic `package.build` key, but `line.split("=").next().trim()` yields `"build"`, not `build`. The exact build.rs existence check at lines 188-190 does not see an external path. Cargo can therefore execute that script before this test, while structure returns Ok and scratch_copy replaces the real manifest with one that omits the script. The same parser is at crates/continuum-effects-network/tests/pr15_no_std_lane.rs:60-62, crates/continuum-effects-process/tests/pr15_no_std_lane.rs:63-65, and crates/continuumd/tests/inv015_agent_least_authority_evidence.rs:440-445. The Python GOV-4-13 checker parses TOML and catches this form, but the promised compiler-lane and INV-015 witnesses can still false-green independently. Parse the real manifest as TOML in the Rust controls, or correctly decode quoted and escaped keys. Reject any semantic build or links key, and add quoted-key and escaped-key mutants that name an external script.
